scope: Supplemental static audit; stage1 fixed review and stage2 PTE review unchanged

findings.finding: get_idx_by_name uses same length AND nonzero strcasecmp as its matching predicate; that selects a different same-length master name rather than an equal name. NULL master names are not guarded.
findings.required: Require strcasecmp==0 and a defined NULL/unknown-name path before any master operation.

findings.finding: Fault decoding contains a seventh per-instance MIC branch although MIC_MAX_MASTER=6. On instance1 this indexes master[12] outside the12-element array. Later __ffs(bitmap&0xffff) is called without a nonzero/range check and its result indexes both master names and callable fault-handler pointers.
findings.required: Mask only valid per-instance master bits, check zero/range before __ffs/indexing/callback/MMIO, and handle L1/L2/unknown faults without inventing a valid master.
